activation: stop at first activation within callback; at most one event per canonical callback; reset hypotheses only, preserve clock and cooldown
clock: advance total_frames by all selected_rows*3 even after activation skips remaining search
empty: selected_rows0 returns all-zero result; decoder state and clock unchanged
finish: one call per clip; process nonempty actual ingress tail once; no empty callback, padding, repetition or EOF flush
logit_softmax: FP64 exp(logit-max), sequential FP64 sum, probabilities rounded FP32; all6 competing tokens retained
path_tie: stable insertion order at equal pb+pnb
reset_per_clip: a20fft64s_reset resets frontend, splice, ingress, model cache, all decoder clocks/cooldown/hypotheses
search_order: hypothesis score order then keyword1 then keyword2
stale_reset: if leading hypothesis first_node older than250 after whole callback clock advance, reset hypotheses
stored_outputs: original callback logits only; no extra probability recomputation
subsequence_scan: inclusive final start <= prefix_length-4, first match per path
topk_tie: pinned libstdc++ nth_element(nth2)+sort first2; strict probability comparator no token-id tie break
